text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock C at a 26.1% loss and then buying Stock A reminded me not to let regret or a desire to make back a loss drive my next trade; I should reassess each holding on its own merits.","My account value rose to 107,949 by Period 10 despite the loss realized on Stock C, so one painful trade does not define the portfolio; I should focus on long-term overall performance.","I should avoid frequent, emotionally driven trading: when I made no trades for several periods, I still had meaningful changes in account value, so patience and a clear plan matter."]}
